snippet.title: Spore Hero Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Spore Hero for Nintendo Wii has arrived! Launching on October 6, Spore Hero features an entirely new Spore adventure far across the galaxy. Create your own creature hero and fight against an alien menace that tries to destroy your new planet. Collect new parts and unlock special abilities to customize your own Spore Hero. Conquer foes (or your friends!) and complete missions while you explore the planet in your quest to save the world. The fate of the world is in your hands.
